implemented_claims: A strict `oya gate validate cloud-iac-gitops-evidence` lane now exists and is registered in the run-all gate catalog.
The gate validates Cloud IaC manifest gitops_evidence_scope against repo-local Argo CD Application template contexts.
The gate validates Application metadata, source/destination placeholders, automated sync options, and credential-like marker absence.
Cloud IaC manifest now declares this gate-backed local filesystem/YAML-template guard while preserving runtime/API/credential non-claims.

The manifest guard now explicitly enforces argoproj.io/v1alpha1/Application as the declared Application kind and placeholder-only metadata posture for repo, revision, cluster, and tenant namespace inputs.
explicit_non_claims: No Argo CD API integration or Kubernetes API integration is implemented.
No repository credentials, kubeconfigs, tokens, passwords, SSH private keys, or raw secret material are stored or configured.
No live sync, diff, health, prune, self-heal, rollout, rollback, or cosign verification is executed.
No provider API, OpenTofu CLI, REST, SDK, worker, measured SLO, DR, sharding, mesh runtime, or capacity telemetry readiness is claimed.
false_green_findings_closed: Manifest GitOps context count can no longer drift from repo-local Argo CD Application templates without failing a first-class Oya gate.
Templates can no longer replace repo/revision/cluster/namespace placeholders with concrete deployment targets without failing the gate.
Templates can no longer drop automated sync safety options or include credential-like markers without failing the gate.
The run-all catalog now includes the Cloud IaC GitOps evidence lane, so the previous implicit/template-only posture is enforced.
Manifest application_kind and metadata_only_posture can no longer drift away from the Argo CD Application/placeholder-only contract without failing the gate.
known_gaps: This is a local filesystem/YAML-template coherence gate, not a live Argo CD service integration.
The gate intentionally does not execute Argo CD, Kubernetes, Git, cosign, provider APIs, or OpenTofu.
Legacy Cloud IaC Markdown/IP/capability prose may still contain future-state planning language and remains de-authorized by manifest non-claims.
Live deployment/runtime/provider/OpenTofu work remains sequentially blocked behind future contract slices.
